d: Prime Minister Narendra Modi has announced a sweeping $1.62 billion (240 billion Nepali rupees) economic and development package for Nepal during a joint press statement with visiting Nepali Prime Minister Balendra "Balen" Shah in New Delhi. Following wide-ranging delegation-level talks at Hyderabad House, the two neighbours agreed to establish an offshore campus of the Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) in Nepal alongside a Start-up Incubator, an Innovation Hub, and an Agro-Industrial Park—while expanding scholarships in Law and Technology for Nepali students.
